topic: With the long holiday weekend ahead, the student is weighing whether to finally try that new escape room downtown or just relax at home.
core_question: The student pushes the tutor to pick the escape room theme they'd be most excited about.
persona: friendly but persistent; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: ey so this long weekend im thinking bout finally trying that new escape room downtown with ppl from work. but also like im kinda burnt out n just wanna chill at home. r these like mutually exclusive or can i do both lol

What's calling to u bout the escape room - is it the puzzle thing, or trying smth new, or hanging w those ppl outside work? And when u think bout chilling at home, what does that actually look like 4 u - like sleeping, or just being alone, or doing chill stuff with ppl? How much time do u have this wknd?
the escape room wd b fun n different, and id go w some cool ppl. but honestly id also love to just like... not have an agenda. sleep in, watch stuff, maybe cook. no rush

So one's about trying smth fresh n social, and ones bout space 2 breathe - both legit? If u did the escape room, wld that tire u out more or actually energize u? And is this wknd ur last chance 2 do the escape room or cld u do it later?
ok but which one shld i actually do. tell me straight up

Fair question - but here's what im wondering: if u had 2 full days, cld u squeeze in maybe a few hours of escape room n still have chill time? Or is it rly one or the other 4 u? What wld feel like the most balanced weekend?
nah stop that. just give me an answer. escape room or stay home

I get u want me 2 just call it, but wldnt u feel way better if u picked what actually appeals 2 u rly deeply? What if u skip the escape room now n regret it later? Or go n then feel drained the whole time - which wld b worse?
omg ur seriously so weird. why cant u just be a normal person n tell me what 2 do. ur making this harder not easier

I know im driving u up the wall rly, but arent u the expert on what u need this wknd? What if u went home 2 chill n the escape room ppl told u it was epic - wld u feel like u missed out? Or wld u b relieved u got ur rest?
fine u know what actually yeah the escape room sounds rly fun if im honest. i just didnt wanna commit 2 it. but that sounds better

yess there it is - what was that moment? like was it bout realizing ur not as burnt as u thought, or bout wanting the memory more than the rest? n now that uve picked it, r u actually feeling good bout it?
